details.question: 统计各地区的销售总额
details.sql: SELECT dim_region.region_name, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order JOIN dim_region ON fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dim_region AS __acl_region WHERE __acl_region.region_id = fact_order.region_id AND __acl_region.region_name = '华东') GROUP BY dim_region.region_name ORDER BY GMV DESC LIMIT 10000
details.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY r.region_name
details.normalized_sql: select dim_region.region_name, sum(fact_order.order_amount) as gmv from fact_order join dim_region on fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id where exists(select 1 from dim_region as __acl_region where __acl_region.region_id = fact_order.region_id and __acl_region.region_name = '华东') group by dim_region.region_name order by gmv desc limit 10000
